summary.content:
Today's selection covers 96 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 60 on Artificial Intelligence and 17 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Agentic AI Is Untamable: Ask the Right Security Questions
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: US charges two over laundering $43 million from investment fraud
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BleepingComputer, Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 53 articles published in the last 24 hours
